item.title: US appeals court rejects Trump bid to implement new vote-by-mail rules
item.description:
Will Americans be able to vote by mail in the 2026 midterm elections? Liliboas iStock/Getty Images Plus The Trump administration’s proposal to crack down on voting by mail in federal elections – articulated in a March 2026 executive order – faces its toughest legal test so far, as the Supreme Court decides whether to allow the measure to go ahead, or maintains a lower court’s block on its implementation. Despite offering no evidence of widespread fraud, the White House has said the many measures it wants to put in place will “ enhance election integrity via the United States Mail .” Those measures include using the Department of Homeland Security, the U.S. Postal Service and the Department of Justice to vet the eligibility of voters , establish new standards for mail ballots and who can use them, and investigate and prosecute any state and local officials who issue federal ballots to…

Sources: Al Jazeera English, The Conversation, The Hill

item.title: Pilot warned Amazon cargo plane going too fast before deadly crash, data shows
item.description:
An Amazon cargo plane crashed at Miami international airport in Florida after overshooting the runway, striking vehicles and resulting in at least five deaths and five injuries. Officials said evidence suggested the pilots considered aborting the landing before the crash. Miami airport is not equipped with 'arresting beds', systems of lightweight, crushable material that the federal aviation authority says have been installed at more than 120 airports nationwide at the end of runways to help safely stop planes that overshoot At least five dead after Amazon cargo plane crashes at Miami airport Continue reading...

Sources: BBC News, The Guardian, Washington Post

item.title: Australia news live: Anthony Albanese marks 25 years since September 11; aged care provider pays back thousands to residents
item.description:
Follow the day’s news live Marles reflects on September 11 Marles reflected on September 11 this morning, saying it was a day in our lifetime “which we remember most as having changed the world in which we live”. I remember on that night watching West Wing, a number of people I have spoken to in the last few days were doing the same thing. When it finished, it cut into this extraordinary vision of smoke coming out of the North Tower. We weren’t really sure what was going on. Then astonishingly it looked as though we were witnessing a plane fly into the South Tower. … What it then heralded was obviously a huge change in terms of wars in … Iraq and Afghanistan. More than 40,000 Australians served over the coming years in those, more than 40 lost their lives. Ten Australians lost their lives that day on September 11. We very much remember them. item.title: Drones recreate Twin Towers in tribute ahead of 9/11 anniversary
item.description:
A drone light show illuminated the New York City skyline Wednesday night during a test for the 'Tribute in Light' installation that will mark the 25th anniversary of the September 11 attacks. A total of 2,977 drones will take part in the display, one for each life lost on September 11, 2001.

Sources: Al Jazeera English, France 24

item.title: Morocco denies involvement in migrant surge into Spain’s Ceuta
item.description:
Moroccan authorities said on Thursday there were "no facts" establishing its involvement in the migrant rush into Spain's North African exclave of Ceuta in July. It was the kingdom's first official response to a Spanish police report accusing its security forces of "total permissiveness" when the mass crossing took place.

Covered by 2 public.
Sources: Al Jazeera English, France 24
